title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → AidApplication

source_tables.description: Aid year activation. One row per student per institution per aid year. The anchor for every other aid record.
ISIR control record: transaction number, receipt date, load status, effective-dated ISIR history.
Student-reported FAFSA data: citizenship, homeless youth and foster care indicators, signature.
Federally computed results: SAI (EFC before 2024-25), dependency status, Pell eligibility, verification selection, C-flags, comment codes.
Student aid attributes by aid year: dependency override, professional judgment indicators, expected enrollment.
FA term record: financial aid load used for expected enrollment.

notes: ISIR record layouts change every aid year, and FAFSA Simplification (2024-25) replaced EFC with SAI and restructured the ISIR. Field names below follow the current delivered layout; confirm them against the regulatory update bundle for each aid year you extract. Pull the ISIR transaction marked active for packaging, not simply the latest.
privacy: RESTRICTED. This is a FERPA education record and GLBA-covered customer financial information. Land in bronze under the restricted KMS key, tokenize SAI, COD loan IDs, and PJ or appeal text at silver, and grant only to financial aid roles (govern/access-control-matrix.json, ACM-SPECIAL-002).
